senses.gloss:
अज्येष्ठ a. Not the eldest or best,
having no elder brothers; ˚वृत्ति not
acting like the eldest brother; or
acting like one who has no elder
brother.

आज्यं [आज्यते, आ-अंज्-क्यप्]
1
Clarified butter, ghee; आज्यधूमोद्गमेन
[]
Ś. 1. 15; (it is often distinguished from
घृत; सपिंविंलीनमाज्यं स्याद् घनीभूतं घृतं भवेत्).
--2 (In a wider sense) Oil, milk
&c. used instead of clarified butter;
घृतं वा यदि वा तैलं पयो वा दधि यावकं ।
आज्यस्याने नियुक्तानामाज्यशब्दो विधीयते ॥.
--3
N. of a sort of chant or religious
service (सामस्तोमभेदः);
आजिमीयुस्तस्मादाज्यानामाज्यत्वं Nir.
--4 Turpentine.
--Comp.
--दोहं a hymn to be
recited by a Sāmavedin.
--प a.
drinking ghee. (--पाः pl.) a class
of Manes who are the sons of
Pulastya and the ancestors of the Vaiśya
order; पुलस्त्यस्याज्यपाः पुत्राः Mb.;
Ms. 3. 197-8.
--पात्रं, --स्थाली a vessel or
dish to hold clarified butter.
--भज्
m. {1} an epithet of Agni (the
consumer of clarified butter). {2}
a god, deity.
--वारिः ‘sea of clarified
butter’, one of the seven seas.
